    table["income"] = table["income"].astype("float64")
    table["city"] = table["city"].str.strip().str.title().fillna("Unknown")
    table["id"] = table["id"].astype("int64")

    missing = [column for column in required if column not in frame.columns]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError("Thiếu cột: " + ", ".join(missing))


def build_dataset(customers, orders):
    people = customers.drop_duplicates(subset="customer_id", keep="first").copy()
    people["name"] = people["name"].str.strip()
    people["city"] = people["city"].str.strip().str.title()
    paid = orders.copy()
    paid["status"] = paid["status"].str.strip().str.lower()
    paid = paid[(paid["status"] == "paid") & paid["amount"].notna()]
    merged = paid.merge(people[["customer_id", "name", "city"]], on="customer_id", how="inner")
    merged = merged[["order_id", "customer_id", "name", "city", "amount"]]

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

COLUMNS = ["id", "district", "area_m2", "rooms", "age", "price_per_m2"]


def clean_housing(df):
    table = df.drop_duplicates(subset="id", keep="first").copy()
    for column in ["area_m2", "rooms", "year_built", "price_million"]:
        table[column] = pd.to_numeric(table[column], errors="coerce")
    table["district"] = table["district"].str.strip().str.title()
    valid = (
        (table["area_m2"] > 0)
        & (table["rooms"] >= 1)
        & (table["year_built"] <= reference_year)
        & (table["price_million"] > 0)
        & table["district"].notna()
    )
    clean = table[valid].copy()
    clean["area_m2"] = clean["area_m2"].astype("float64")
    clean["rooms"] = clean["rooms"].astype("int64")
    clean["age"] = (reference_year - clean["year_built"]).astype("int64")
    clean["price_per_m2"] = clean["price_million"] / clean["area_m2"]
    return clean[COLUMNS].reset_index(drop=True)


def standardize_columns(matrix):
    mean = matrix.mean(axis=0)
    std = matrix.std(axis=0)
    return (matrix - mean) / np.where(std == 0, 1.0, std)


def prepare(df):
    clean = clean_housing(df)
    features = clean[["area_m2", "rooms", "age"]].to_numpy(dtype=float)
    by_district = clean.groupby("district")["price_per_m2"].mean()
    stats = {
        "rows": int(len(clean)),
        "rejected": int(len(df) - len(clean)),
        "mean_price_per_m2": float(clean["price_per_m2"].mean()),
        "by_district": {str(name): float(value) for name, value in by_district.items()},
    }
    return {"clean": clean, "X": standardize_columns(features), "stats": stats}


def plot_diagnostic(clean):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.scatter(clean["area_m2"], clean["price_per_m2"])
    ax.set_title("Giá mỗi m2 theo diện tích")
    ax.set_xlabel("Diện tích (m2)")
    ax.set_ylabel("Giá mỗi m2 (triệu đồng)")
    return ax

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

REQUIRED_COLUMNS = ["image_id", "width", "height", "label", "xmin", "ymin", "xmax", "ymax", "split"]
SPLITS = ["train", "val", "test"]
NUMERIC = ["width", "height", "xmin", "ymin", "xmax", "ymax"]
KEY = ["image_id", "label", "xmin", "ymin", "xmax", "ymax"]


def clean_annotations(df, allowed_labels):
    missing = [column for column in REQUIRED_COLUMNS if column not in df.columns]
    if missing:
        raise ValueError("Thiếu cột: " + ", ".join(missing))
    table = df[REQUIRED_COLUMNS].copy()
    for column in NUMERIC:
        table[column] = pd.to_numeric(table[column], errors="coerce")
    for column in ["image_id", "label", "split"]:
        table[column] = table[column].str.strip()
    table["label"] = table["label"].str.lower()
    table["split"] = table["split"].str.lower()
    valid = (
        table["image_id"].notna()
        & (table["image_id"] != "")
        & (table["width"] > 0)
        & (table["height"] > 0)
        & (table["xmin"] >= 0)
        & (table["ymin"] >= 0)
        & (table["xmin"] < table["xmax"])
        & (table["ymin"] < table["ymax"])
        & (table["xmax"] <= table["width"])
        & (table["ymax"] <= table["height"])
        & table["label"].isin(allowed_labels)
        & table["split"].isin(SPLITS)
    )
    table = table[valid].drop_duplicates(subset=KEY, keep="first")
    table = table.astype(
        {"width": "int64", "height": "int64", "xmin": "float64", "ymin": "float64", "xmax": "float64", "ymax": "float64"}
    )
    return table.reset_index(drop=True)


def normalize_boxes(clean):
    out = clean[["image_id", "label", "split"]].copy()
    out["x1"] = clean["xmin"] / clean["width"]
    out["y1"] = clean["ymin"] / clean["height"]
    out["x2"] = clean["xmax"] / clean["width"]
    out["y2"] = clean["ymax"] / clean["height"]
    return out


def class_summary(clean):
    area = (clean["xmax"] - clean["xmin"]) * (clean["ymax"] - clean["ymin"]) / (clean["width"] * clean["height"])
    grouped = clean.assign(area=area).groupby("label")
    summary = pd.DataFrame(
        {
            "boxes": grouped.size(),
            "images": grouped["image_id"].nunique(),
            "mean_area": grouped["area"].mean(),
        }
    )
    summary["share"] = summary["boxes"] / len(clean)
    summary = summary[["boxes", "images", "share", "mean_area"]]
    summary = summary.reset_index().sort_values(["boxes", "label"], ascending=[False, True])
    return summary.set_index("label")


def plot_class_distribution(summary):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.bar(list(summary.index), list(summary["boxes"]))
    ax.set_title("Phân bố lớp annotation")
    ax.set_xlabel("Lớp")
    ax.set_ylabel("Số bounding box")
    return ax

        norm["y2"] - norm["y1"],
    ]
)
